raw_response:
This is my family's main plot and we need maize for nsima — if the maize fails, we don't eat. I managed to get FISP coupons this year so I will use the subsidized NPK and urea, though I have to stretch it across both my plots so it won't be as much as the agriculture officer recommends. I also carry the goat manure to the field before the rains because I cannot afford to rely only on fertilizer. I will plant hybrid seed from the coupon on most of the plot and intercrop with pigeon pea like my neighbors do, and the weeding I do myself with my sister — we cannot afford much ganyu labor.
